card: One camp rulebook: each intent's legality, effect, preview and options in one row
guards: case 5: campActions ids+labels on 10 planted sessions byte-equal to a capture taken at HEAD d633490 before the refactor (13947 bytes, sha256 93da01631b72...; camp files unchanged since 2d83a1e)
case 6: golden-nights (director.test.ts) and golden-mornings (tools camp-evidence.test.ts) unchanged and green
deviations_from_card: Legality extras are NOT moved into rows: legalProblem's per-intent checks sit on both sides of activityFitsDay (TRAIN stat and PROTECT gold before it, CONFIDE/SCHEME/PLOT/OFFER/DEFECT/RECRUIT after), so one row hook would reorder verdict reasons; demoted to stay byte-exact and under the line ceiling. Legality the rows do carry: needsPresence (playerProblem) and capFor (playerProblem + reconcile). remainingCaps keeps its _eve key strip (it rewrites the Tables cap keys for reconcile, so it is not a cap read). Commit order is refactor then test, not test then refactor, so that every commit is green (the test imports the new module).
notes: For Slot B: each contested row exposes contests by name - campRules.WATCH.contests.WATCH, REPORT.REPORT, SCHEME.SCHEME + SCHEME.CAUGHT, RECRUIT.RECRUIT - each (rules, actor, target, args) => {action, bonus, dc}, and resolve rolls exactly `bonus + die(actor, action) > dc` through ctx.roll. The SCHEME dc includes the hidden b.warned term, so a preview must pass the target with warned:false. The 'Guile contest' preview strings live in the rows (camp-rules.ts), and campView gains read campRules[intent].preview. camp.ts 970 -> 693 lines, camp-session.ts 584 -> 498, camp-rules.ts 287 (+ 112-line test). camp-rules.ts imports calendar from camp.ts, a runtime cycle that is only used at call time. Exported from packages/core/src/index.ts (lock taken and released). The first whole-tree gate runs went red on sibling in-flight arena files (enemy-behaviour.test.ts parse error, enemies.ts exports), and the final run is green with 735 vitest tests.
